name: AIT Corporation
summary: AIT Corporation operates as a comprehensive logistics company in Japan, China, and internationally. The company provides marine, air freight, motor truck, railroad cargo, and coastal transport freight forwarding; airfreight agency, customs clearance, warehousing, and ship brokerage services; and operates as an import and export, and nonlife insurance agency. It also sells and imports/exports containers and other transportation equipment; and clothing, chemicals, electromechanical parts, daily necessities, exterior products, food products, medicines, and automotive supplies. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
